assessment_architecture.retry_policy: below 80% permits correction and parallel retake; earned mastery is never downgraded

evidence_principles: Synthetic speech is practice support, not proof of independent listening.
Visible-text fallback cannot be recorded as listening proficiency.
Recognition scores remain distinct from independent writing and speaking evidence.
Reviewer metadata records role and evidence context without requiring a privileged account.
No new curriculum version may erase or downgrade earned legacy completion.
